connector.name: Japan Real Estate Intel
connector.registryDescription: Japan real estate MCP: land price, risk, foot traffic, renovation. 10 prefectures.
connector.summary: Hosted at realestate-mcp.jp over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package japan-real-estate-intel-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sugukurukabe account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
